title: New-file diff header shows only '+N', omitting the '−0' side the design always renders
observed: write-new-file's diff header for a new file reads 'src/middleware/rateLimit.ts  new file' followed only by '+3' (01-write-diff.txt), no removals count at all.
expected: Design's diff header always shows both counts, e.g. the block-anatomy example in internal/tui/transcript.go:254 itself documents '+2  −0', and Terminal.dc.html's stat builder (line 364: d.addS='+'+a; d.delS='−'+r) sets delS unconditionally even when r is 0 for an all-additions new-file diff (DIFF1, all A() lines). qa/reference/diff.png shows both signs together ('+2 -1').
design_ref: docs/kiln-design-handoff/Terminal.dc.html:363-364; internal/tui/transcript.go:234-247 diffCountsRow (comment: 'omitting a zero side' — contradicts its own doc-comment example at line 254 showing '+2  −0')
